title: Student Transportation Services Eligibility Schedule: Transportation Types, Grounds and Seat Priority
content:
Student Transportation Services assigns every rider under one of seven transportation types. Each type rests on its own ground of eligibility, serves a set list of grades and holds a fixed place in the seat priority order used when a route is full (1 is seated first).

## Schedule of types

| Transportation type | Ground of eligibility | Distance test against the two-mile threshold | Record requirement | Grades served | Seat priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) | courtesy seat, space available | distance under the threshold | enrollment type that keeps district transportation eligibility | KG, 01 through 12 | 6 |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | courtesy seat, space available | distance under the threshold | enrollment type that keeps district transportation eligibility | KG, 01 through 12 | 5 |
| Regular Route Eligibility | distance of two miles | distance at or above the threshold | enrollment type that keeps district transportation eligibility | KG, 01 through 12 | 3 |
| Hazardous Route Eligibility | residence in a hazardous route zone | distance under the threshold | enrollment type that keeps district transportation eligibility | KG, 01 through 12 | 3 |
| Choice Program Hub Shuttle | choice program hub | any distance | enrollment type that qualifies for the hub shuttle | KG, 01 through 12 | 4 |
| McKinney-Vento School-of-Origin Transportation | school of origin under McKinney-Vento | any distance | homeless (McKinney-Vento) designation on the student record | PK3, PK4, KG, 01 through 12 | 2 |
| Special Education Transportation | IEP related service | any distance | active IEP listing special transportation as a related service | PK3, PK4, KG, 01 through 12 | 1 |

Each type carries only the record requirement shown in its row: the courtesy, regular and hazardous types do not require the hub-shuttle enrollment, a homeless designation or an IEP; the hub shuttle does not require an enrollment type that keeps district transportation eligibility; the McKinney-Vento and Special Education types require neither enrollment test.

## Measurement and zones

- **Two-mile threshold.** The state regular-transportation distance is 2.00 miles for every type: a residence-to-campus distance at or above 2.00 miles is the distance at which regular route service is owed.
- **How distance is measured.** For every type the distance is the district routing system's shortest public road route from the residence address to the campus entrance.
- **Hazardous route zones.** Hazardous Route Eligibility lists the board-approved hazardous traffic zones whose residents within two miles qualify: HZ-01 Ranch Road 2243 Corridor, HZ-02 Calloway Creek Rail Crossing and HZ-03 State Highway 195 Frontage. No other type lists a zone.

## Waiting order and school of origin

| Transportation type | Order in which applications wait when the route has no free seat | Which campus is the school of origin |
|---|---|---|
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) and Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | by application date | not applicable |
| Regular Route, Hazardous Route, Choice Program Hub Shuttle, Special Education Transportation | not applicable | not applicable |
| McKinney-Vento School-of-Origin Transportation | not applicable | the last school attended when permanently housed, or the school last enrolled in |

## Reading the schedule (examples, hypothetical riders)

- A third grader living 2.00 miles exactly from the campus entrance by the routing system's shortest public road route meets the distance test of Regular Route Eligibility; at 1.99 miles the same rider is under the threshold.
- A PK4 student is not served by the courtesy, regular, hazardous or hub types, whose grade lists start at KG; McKinney-Vento School-of-Origin Transportation and Special Education Transportation serve PK3 and PK4.
- When a route is full, a Special Education Transportation rider (priority 1) is seated before a Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) rider (priority 5), who is seated before a Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) rider (priority 6).
